identification: Large oval carved shell cameo brooch (lady in profile with flowers at shoulder) in a pierced gold frame with applied flowerheads and leaves, pin back. Catalogue says '22ct lined', so frame may be gold-lined/gold-filled rather than solid 9ct; the frame style matches common 9ct pierced-leaf Italian frames.

searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'cameo brooch', 'shell cameo gold', 'carved shell cameo'; work/comps.py: 'cameo brooch'. Eleven same-item or close entries kept. Comparable 9ct shell cameos of similar size sold about $90 to $190 at Noble, Lawsons and Davidson (non-local); local Gowans/Armitage paid $100 to $330. Rolled gold example $5. Ceiling or floor depends wholly on whether the frame is solid 9ct. | chrome: Terapeak AU as above.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold (Terapeak): 'large shell cameo brooch 9ct gold' and 'cameo brooch rolled gold' (last 90 days, Australia); 'cameo brooch 22ct'. Also Leski Auctions, Noble Numismatics, Lawsons and Theodore Bruce realised prices for 'shell cameo brooch gold' since 2023.
viewing_check: Read the hallmark on frame and pin (9ct vs 'lined'), weigh it, check shell for cracks/chips, pin catch and safety chain.
